title: Artificial neural network model of the capacity of diethylenetriamine functionalised zinc oxide-apricot stone shell nanocomposite for sequestering 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid from wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14199-14215

A novel nanocomposite, diethylenetriamine functionalised zinc oxide-apricot stone shell (ZnO@Ap/DETA), has been synthesised for the efficient sequestration of 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4-D).
